senses.en_definition: This is; here is (used to emphasize the person, thing, time, or reason being indicated).

messages.en: This is the bag I said I wanted to buy the other day. Nice, right?
It is! But is it big enough? Will your laptop fit?
My internet at home is so slow. That file still hasn't gone through.
No worries, just send it when your internet's working properly again.
I've read the notes, but is the iris the same as the pupil?
No. The iris is the coloured part. The pupil is just the opening in the middle of the iris.
Ugh, I only just wiped the table, and now there's water spilled on it again!
It's okay, I'll grab a cloth from the kitchen.
